choices.content: \(C\) and \(r\) are variables; \(2\pi\) is a constant
\(r\) is a variable; \(C\) and \(2\pi\) are constants
\(C\) is a variable; \(r\) and \(2\pi\) are constants

question.prompt: In the circle circumference formula \(C=2\pi r\), which quantities are variables and which are constants?

solutions.explanation: As the radius \(r\) changes, the circumference \(C\) changes with it, so both are variables. The value of \(2\pi\) remains unchanged, so it is a constant.
solutions.title: Identify changing and fixed quantities
